text:
mike (sre): creating follow-up thread for this morning's partial 502s + TLS handshake failures on cross-region calls (us-east -> eu-west). saw spike ~07:42 UTC.

net-bot: alert: route_tls_errors high on /v1/complete at 2026-03-22T07:42:10Z · 5xx spike + TLS alerts

anna (networking): quick triage: captured short pcap showing same source IP initiating handshake that later hits a different LB cert within ~20s. suspect ephemeral port reuse + NAT path change.

dave (eng-runtime): logs show TLS alert 40 and occasional "unknown certificate" when SNI present. KV cache cold noted during window.

mike (sre): repro suggestion for infra team:
```
kubectl run -it --rm testcurl --image=curlimages/curl --restart=Never -- sh -c "for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -sS -H 'Host: api.redwood.internal' https://api.redwood.internal/health || echo fail:$i; sleep 1; done"
```

anna (networking): action N1: run 20m tcpdump on egress-nat-east-1, save filtered pcap and check for port reuse within handshake windows. owner: anna. ETA: 2026-03-23 12:00 UTC.

dave (eng-runtime): action N2 (mitigation): enable temporary 500ms backoff on cross-region retries and enable session stickiness for 2h. owner: dave. ETA: 2026-03-22 10:30 UTC.

mike (sre): action N3: add lightweight TLS debug logs (SNI, cert CN, route_id) to proxy spans for 72h. owner: mike. ETA: 2026-03-23 09:00 UTC.

cloud-eng: opening provider case to request AS-path traces and NAT gateway port usage counters. owner: cloud-eng. ETA: 2026-03-25 18:00 UTC. case_id will be posted here.

anna (networking): note: I also see brief routing updates in control-plane logs overlapping the error window; will correlate.

dave (eng-runtime): will post PR for stickiness toggle: github.com/redwood/route-config/pull/498.

mike (sre): scheduled sync 2026-03-23 15:00 UTC to review pcaps and provider reply. marking thread as canonical follow-up for this incident. please drop artifacts here. :thumbsup:

net-bot: incident state -> mitigated (2026-03-22 08:05 UTC)
